From: Jan de Vries <jan@example.org>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2004 07:45:00 +0100
Subject: Morning walk

<p>Walked along the dike before breakfast. The wind came hard from the west and
the sky was <b>grey</b> all the way to the horizon.<br>
Saw two herons.</p>

<p>Back home I made coffee and read the paper. Nothing much in it, except a long
piece about the new bridge, which apparently will be finished <i>next year</i>.

Later I want to write more about the walk. See also [[Notes]].
